messages.content: I am locked out of my corporate email after entering the wrong password three times.
Your account has entered a temporary 15-minute security cooldown. You can reset your password immediately via the IT Self-Service portal at https://identity.internal using your hardware MFA token.
How do I request access to the production Kubernetes cluster?
Submit an Access Request ticket under the DevOps catalog, obtain approval from your engineering manager, and complete the production safety training module.
Can I get a replacement USB-C charging adapter for my laptop?
Hardware accessories can be requested through the Hardware Catalog without manager approval if the replacement cost is under $50. Visit the IT Helpdesk on Floor 3 for immediate pickup.
What is the procedure for reporting a phishing email?
Do not click any links or download attachments. Click the 'Report Phishing' button in the Outlook toolbar, or forward the email as an attachment to security-ops@internal.
The conference room display in Olympus 4A is showing 'No Signal'.
Ensure the HDMI cable is connected to the wall transmitter and power cycle the wall controller by holding the Power button for 5 seconds. If unresolved, AV dispatch will assist within 20 minutes.
